problem_restatement.input: The original report-only BRENTOIL oil-shock observer stopped when Hyperliquid revised a completed candle after its first observation.
problem_restatement.required_output: Resume causal evidence collection without rewriting old evidence, weakening source checks, or changing the live v53 portfolio.
success_criteria: Preserve the original observer ledger and its eligible short decision exactly as recorded.
Start a separately identified prospective window at a new cursor boundary.
Record every new completed five-minute decision once with no order or signing authority.
Fail closed on any source revision in the new window.

recommendation: Continue the new BRENTOIL report-only window and resolve its first source-native oil-shock lifecycle if one occurs. Do not restore Range Onset, retired Swing, or the cross-asset breakout transfer; do not tune the threshold from this one non-action decision.
why_now: The stale observer was a technical dead end, but BRENTOIL remains a liquid and diversifying candidate. A clean prospective epoch is the lowest-risk way to test the distinct oil-shock mechanism without contaminating prior evidence.
evidence_reviewed: Original 433-decision observer ledger and exact stopped status.
Two public candle revisions, including one signal-bearing close revision.
New 2,303-candle bootstrap ledger and first post-bootstrap decision.
Existing three-trade canary reconciliation and negative-stress development result.
observed_problem_or_opportunity: The source transport is running again under a clean epoch. No prospective economic edge is established because the new window has zero eligible signals and zero lifecycles.
applicable_market_regime: Five-minute outsized BRENTOIL return shocks followed by a frozen mean-reversion onset; regime context is descriptive and does not silently gate the trial.
alternatives_considered: Overwrite or tolerate the revised candle; rejected because it would corrupt causal evidence.
Restart against the old immutable ledger; rejected because the exact fail-closed exception reproduces.
Restore Range Onset or retired Swing; rejected because they do not answer the distinct oil-shock hypothesis.
Drop BRENTOIL immediately; deferred because the new mechanism has not yet produced a prospective lifecycle.
expected_upside: A fully attributable oil-specific lifecycle can test diversification and after-cost execution without exposing live capital.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: The public candle source may revise another signal field.
Shock signals may be too sparse for timely inference.
Development stress economics are negative and historical paths are unresolved.
The three-trade canary result is largest-winner dependent and belongs to different strategy identities.
validation_completed: Reproduced the old fail-closed source-revision error.
Bootstrapped a separate cursor and ledger root.
Observed the first new completed decision with 205-millisecond delay.
Confirmed zero signer, order, promotion, or live-runtime authority.
validation_still_required: At least one complete prospective lifecycle per side before bidirectional inference.
Exact entry, exit, fee, funding, slippage, and path-quality reconciliation.
Positive stress economics excluding the largest winner in predeclared OOS evidence.
Continued zero source-revision accounting in the new epoch.
success_metrics: Every new completed five-minute bar produces exactly one decision.
Zero signal-field revisions and zero duplicate decisions.
Every eligible signal is followed by a fully resolved lifecycle.
Stress net and profit factor remain positive after removing the largest winner.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any signal-field revision or source-identity mismatch stops the observer.
Any missing or duplicate decision invalidates the window.
Resolved prospective lifecycles remain negative or outlier-dependent.
Venue liquidity or measured friction becomes incompatible with planned size.
confidence_level: High confidence in the source-revision diagnosis and observer isolation; low confidence in repeatable profitability until prospective lifecycles resolve.
claim_falsifiers: A byte audit showing the old signal candle never changed would falsify the source-revision diagnosis.
Any new observer-produced order, signer, or live-route change would falsify isolation.
A sufficiently sized negative after-cost, ex-largest-winner forward sample would falsify the economic hypothesis.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve the first source-native BRENTOIL v2 oil-shock lifecycle while the independent HYPE-native lifecycle watcher continues; do not repeat the already rejected SPCX archive reacquisition.
